The '''1977 FA Charity Shield''' was the 55th [[FA Community Shield|FA Charity Shield]], an annual [[association football|football]] match played between the winners of the previous season's [[Football League First Division|First Division]] and [[FA Cup]] competitions. The match was played on 13 August 1977 at [[Wembley Stadium (1923)|Wembley Stadium]] and contested by [[Liverpool F.C.|Liverpool]], who had won the [[The Football League 1976–77|1976–77 First Division]], and [[Manchester United F.C.|Manchester United]], who had won the [[FA Cup 1976–77|1976–77 FA Cup]]. The teams played out a goalless draw and shared the Charity Shield.
